search_text: published ZDI-25-352 ZDI-CAN-26079 Pioneer DMH-WT7600NEX Software Update Signing Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity Vulnerability 2025-06-11 CVE-2025-5832 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-5832 6.8 AV:P/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Pioneer'] ['DMH-WT7600NEX'] This vulnerability allows physically present attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Pioneer DMH-WT7600NEX devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the software update verification process. The issue results from the lack of validating all the data in the software update. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Fixed in Version 3.07 https://www.pioneerelectronics.com/PUSA/Support/Downloads ['2025-01-14 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2025-06-11 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2025-08-28 - Advisory Updated'] Dmitry "InfoSecDJ" Janushkevich of Trend Micro Zero Day Initiative https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-25-352/
title: Pioneer DMH-WT7600NEX Software Update Signing Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows physically present attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Pioneer DMH-WT7600NEX devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the software update verification process. The issue results from the lack of validating all the data in the software update. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device.
